label: A helium plant hit, and only selective surgeries left
description: A third of the world's helium tied to a plant Iran struck, which he says affects MRI machines and chips, feeding into trade wars over medical supplies where elective surgeries stop and patients cannot be put under anaesthesia. He says himself he does not know what causes the anaesthesia shortage. Helium is genuinely used to cool MRI magnets, so the mechanism is real, which makes the surgical claim checkable.
aliases: That you won't be able to have surgeries
they would not be able to put you underneath anesthesia

label: Friday worship in white clothes to the Mahdi, in American cities
description: From the tribulation visitation he describes, everyone gathering to worship on Fridays in white clothes to Allah and the Mahdi, which he says was not happening in America in 2014 and is now visible, pointing to a New York street gathering with the mayor and a large mosque. What he shows is ordinary public prayer, so the distinguishing part of the claim is the compulsion and the white clothing.
aliases: But Jesus said they'll worship on Fridays
they'll all have to wear white white clothes
None of this like this in 2014 was happening

label: An oil refinery in Israel, glowing, with lights on the tubes
description: A major oil refinery in Israel seen glowing, with tubes and what looks like a storage facility, lights shining on it. Israel has two refineries, at Haifa and Ashdod, so the target set is small enough to check. He does not say what happens to it, only that he sees it lit.
aliases: I see a major oil refinery in Israel
it's the tubes. All these tubes
I see these lights shining on this

label: A young man in a hoodie in California is in danger
description: In a burst of tongues and prayer he says three times that a young man in a hoodie in California is in danger, that he has hotels and that he has security already, and prays protection over him. Nobody is named. The hoodie, California and the hotels are the only identifying details, which is enough to recognise a match but not to fail cleanly.
aliases: The young man is in danger with the hoodie
The young man is in danger in California
